name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
short_description: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments to all landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: ₹6,000 annually credited directly into bank accounts in 3 installments of ₹2,000 every four months via DBT.
eligible_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and landholding farmer families with cultivable land registered in their name.
income_criteria: Excludes institutional landholders, income tax payers, and serving/retired government employees.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account
application_info: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or through nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or State Agriculture Department office.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
short_description: Free secondary and tertiary healthcare hospitalization cover of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for bottom 40% vulnerable citizens.
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to health services up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 28,000+ empaneled hospitals. Also extends ₹5 Lakh cover to all citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income.
eligible_beneficiaries: Families identified by SECC 2011 database, NFSA ration card holders, and all senior citizens aged 70 and above under expanded PM-JAY.
income_criteria: BPL families / Low income as per SECC census. No income limit for citizens aged 70+.
application_info: Visit nearest empaneled government hospital or CSC, verify identity via Aadhaar, and generate Ayushman Card instantly.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
short_description: Monthly pension assistance to destitute and elderly citizens living Below Poverty Line (BPL).
benefits: Monthly pension ranging from ₹500 to ₹3,000 (Central component ₹200-₹500 supplemented heavily by state governments).
eligible_beneficiaries: Citizens aged 60 years or above belonging to a household living Below the Poverty Line (BPL).
income_criteria: Must belong to Below Poverty Line (BPL) household or hold a BPL card.
required_documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Birth Certificate)
BPL Ration Card or BPL Certificate
application_info: Apply through Social Welfare Department, local Panchayat / Block Development Office (BDO) or Municipality.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
short_description: Monthly financial pension to widowed women living below poverty line.
benefits: Monthly pension ranging from ₹500 to ₹2,500 transferred directly to bank account via DBT.
eligible_beneficiaries: Widowed women aged between 40 and 79 years belonging to BPL households.
income_criteria: Below Poverty Line (BPL) household status required.
required_documents: Age Proof of the Widow (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
BPL Card or Income Certificate from Tehsildar
application_info: Apply at Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal Office, or Social Welfare Department.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांग पेंशन योजना
short_description: Monthly disability pension for citizens with 80% or multiple severe disabilities living below poverty line.
benefits: Monthly financial pension assistance of ₹500 to ₹3,000 per month directly into bank account via DBT.
eligible_beneficiaries: Persons aged 18 years and above with severe or multiple disabilities (80% or more) from BPL households.
income_criteria: BPL cardholder household.
required_documents: Disability Certificate / UDID Card certifying 80%+ disability
application_info: Submit application to District Social Welfare Officer or local Block Development Office (BDO).

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
short_description: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after reaching age 60 for unorganized sector workers.
benefits: Guaranteed lifelong pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month from age 60, based on monthly contribution. Spouse continues pension upon subscriber's death.
eligible_beneficiaries: All Indian citizens aged between 18 and 40 years holding a savings bank account, who are not income-tax payers.
income_criteria: Must not be an income-tax payer as per rules effective from October 2022.
application_info: Visit any bank branch or post office where you have a savings account, or apply via net banking / mobile app.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
short_description: Financial grant to rural homeless and families living in kutcha/dilapidated houses to build a pucca house.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult states, plus 90-95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA and ₹12,000 for toilet construction.
eligible_beneficiaries: Homeless families or households living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha walls and kutcha roof as per SECC census.
income_criteria: Low income / Kutcha house dweller verified by Gram Sabha.
required_documents: Consent for Aadhaar usage and land/site photo
application_info: Gram Panchayat prepares beneficiary list based on SECC and Awaas+ survey. Contact local Panchayat Secretary or Block Office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U)
short_description: Interest subsidy and financial assistance to urban poor and middle-class families for purchasing or constructing a pucca house.
benefits: Interest subsidy of up to 4% on home loans up to ₹25 Lakh for EWS/LIG/MIG families, providing up to ₹1.80 Lakh subsidy assistance.
eligible_beneficiaries: Urban families who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Family should include husband, wife, and unmarried children.
income_criteria: EWS (income up to ₹3 Lakh), LIG (income ₹3-6 Lakh), MIG (income up to ₹9 Lakh).
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Income Proof / Salary Slip / Income Certificate
application_info: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or via approved lending banks and housing finance companies.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
short_description: Government-backed savings scheme for girl child education and marriage with high interest and tax exemption.
benefits: High compound interest rate (8.2% p.a.), exempt under Section 80C, partial withdrawal at age 18 for higher education, full maturity at 21 years.
eligible_beneficiaries: Girl child residing in India, below the age of 10 years at the time of account opening (up to 2 girls per family).
income_criteria: No income restriction. Open to all parents/guardians with eligible girl child.
required_documents: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child
Identity Proof of Parent/Guardian (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
Photographs of Girl Child and Guardian
application_info: Open account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch with minimum initial deposit of ₹250.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
short_description: End-to-end holistic support, skill training, toolkits, and low-interest collateral-free loans for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
benefits: Free skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 modern toolkit grant, collateral-free loans up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest rate, and PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card.
eligible_beneficiaries: Artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools in 18 specified trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, cobbler, mason, etc.).
income_criteria: Self-employed traditional artisan or artisan family; no government employee in the family.
application_info: Register at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with trade verification by Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
short_description: Free LPG gas connection with first refill and stove to adult women from poor households.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection, free first LPG cylinder refill, free hotplate (gas stove), and targeted subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder for up to 12 refills a year.
eligible_beneficiaries: Adult women (18+ years) from poor/BPL households, SC/ST families, or PM Awas Yojana beneficiaries having no existing LPG connection.
income_criteria: Belonging to BPL household or economically weaker section without existing LPG.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the Woman Applicant
Bank Account Number and IFSC Code
application_info: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or submit application form at any local LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas).

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGA)
name_hi: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना
short_description: Legal guarantee of at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per year, unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days, direct bank transfer of statutory wages.
eligible_beneficiaries: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.
income_criteria: Rural resident household, no income ceiling.
required_documents: Bank or Post Office Account Details
application_info: Apply to local Gram Panchayat in writing or orally for Job Card issuance, and submit work demand application.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
short_description: Maternity cash incentive of ₹5,000 for first child and ₹6,000 for second girl child for pregnant and lactating mothers.
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments for 1st live birth, and ₹6,000 in single installment if 2nd child is a girl, compensating for wage loss and ensuring nutrition.
eligible_beneficiaries: Pregnant women and lactating mothers (PW&LM) who are 19 years of age or above (excluding regular government employees).
income_criteria: Family income below ₹8 Lakh, or holder of E-Shram / NFSA / BPL / PM-JAY card.
required_documents: Bank Account details of the mother (DBT linked)
application_info: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre or approved healthcare facility, or apply online at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
short_description: Collateral-free micro loans up to ₹20 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
benefits: Three tiers of loans: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), and Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh) without collateral or third-party guarantee.
eligible_beneficiaries: Any Indian citizen with a business plan for non-farm income generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector.
income_criteria: Viable business proposal; good credit track record without default.
required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
Bank Account Statement for last 6 months
application_info: Apply online at udyamimitra.in or submit loan proposal to any commercial bank, RRB, or Small Finance Bank.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
name_hi: पीएम स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि (स्वनिधि योजना)
short_description: Affordable collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹50,000 to street vendors with 7% interest subsidy.
benefits: Initial working capital loan of ₹10,000, followed by ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on timely repayment, with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions up to ₹1,200/year.
eligible_beneficiaries: Street vendors and hawkers vending in urban and peri-urban areas on or before March 2020.
income_criteria: Active street vendor verified by Urban Local Body (ULB) / Town Vending Committee.
required_documents: Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by ULB
application_info: Apply on pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in portal or via banking correspondents or Common Service Centres.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
short_description: Comprehensive low-premium crop insurance against natural calamities, pests, and post-harvest losses.
benefits: Farmers pay uniform premium of only 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops; full balance covered by Government.
eligible_beneficiaries: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
income_criteria: All farmers growing notified crops, no income ceiling.
required_documents: Land Ownership Record / Khasra-Khatauni / Tenant Agreement
Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari / Village Agriculture Officer
application_info: Enroll via National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in), bank branch, or authorized insurance intermediary before cutoff date.

name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme (KCC)
short_description: Timely short-term crop loans up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective interest rate of only 4% per annum.
benefits: Short-term credit for crop cultivation, harvesting, animal husbandry, and fisheries. Base interest rate of 7% reduced to 4% with prompt repayment incentive.
eligible_beneficiaries: All individual/joint farmers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and SHGs of farmers.
income_criteria: Cultivable landholder or animal husbandry / fisheries rearer.
required_documents: Proof of Land Holding certified by Revenue Authority
application_info: Submit application to any commercial bank, regional rural bank (RRB), or cooperative bank.

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
short_description: Free 5 kg food grains (rice/wheat) per person per month to over 80 crore poor citizens under NFSA.
benefits: 100% free distribution of 5 kg food grains (wheat/rice) per person per month for Priority Households and 35 kg per family for Antyodaya households.
eligible_beneficiaries: All Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration cardholders across India.
income_criteria: Belonging to NFSA priority household / BPL ration card.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Family Members (linked with Ration Card)
application_info: Collect free food grains every month from nearest Fair Price Shop (Ration Dealer) using biometric/e-PoS authentication.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
short_description: Life insurance cover of ₹2,00,000 for death due to any reason at an annual premium of ₹436.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 payable to the nominee upon subscriber's death due to any cause. Premium is auto-debited once a year (₹436/year).
eligible_beneficiaries: Citizens aged between 18 and 50 years holding a savings bank account with consent for auto-debit.
income_criteria: Open to all bank account holders, no income ceiling.
application_info: Enroll through your bank branch, net banking, or post office payments bank with simple auto-debit consent.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
short_description: Accidental death and disability insurance cover of up to ₹2,00,000 at a nominal premium of ₹20 per year.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or total permanent disability; ₹1,00,000 for permanent partial disability. Annual premium of only ₹20.
eligible_beneficiaries: Citizens aged between 18 and 70 years holding an active bank or post office savings account.
income_criteria: Open to all citizens, no income restriction.
application_info: Submit enrollment slip at your bank or activate via mobile banking app.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
short_description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to SC, ST, and Women borrowers for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Composite loans (term loan and working capital) between ₹10 Lakh and ₹100 Lakh covering up to 85% of project cost for non-farm ventures.
eligible_beneficiaries: SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs above 18 years of age setting up first-time greenfield business.
income_criteria: Viable greenfield manufacturing, service, agriculture allied, or trading venture.
required_documents: Bank Statements and Proof of Address
application_info: Apply online at standupmitra.in or approach any commercial bank branch.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
short_description: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to prevent dropout at class 8.
benefits: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) from Class 9 to Class 12 paid directly to student's bank account via DBT.
eligible_beneficiaries: Students studying in government or government-aided schools who passed class 7 with at least 55% marks and qualify the state NMMSS exam.
income_criteria: Parental annual income from all sources not more than ₹3,50,000.
required_documents: Parental Income Certificate (issued by competent authority)
Student Bank Account linked to Aadhaar
application_info: Register and submit application on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with school verification.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
name_hi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों के लिए उत्तर मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
short_description: Full tuition fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance for SC students pursuing post-matriculation courses.
benefits: Complete compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/year credited via DBT.
eligible_beneficiaries: Scheduled Caste students studying in recognized post-secondary courses (Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Degree, PG, Ph.D.).
income_criteria: Annual parental/guardian income from all sources not exceeding ₹2,50,000.
required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
application_info: Submit application through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or state scholarship portal.

name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Aids and Appliances (ADIP Scheme)
name_hi: दिव्यांगजनों को सहायता एवं उपकरण योजना
short_description: Free high-quality modern assistive devices, hearing aids, tricycles, wheelchairs, and motorized vehicles for persons with disabilities.
benefits: 100% free distribution of durable assistive devices (smart cane, hearing aids, wheelchairs, prosthetics, braille kits, motorized tricycles) to eligible disabled persons.
eligible_beneficiaries: Indian citizens with 40% or more benchmark disability certified by a government medical board.
income_criteria: Full assistance if monthly family income is up to ₹20,000; 50% aid if income is between ₹20,001 and ₹30,000.
application_info: Attend ALIMCO assessment camps organized through district administration or apply via ALIMCO portal or District Disability Rehabilitation Centre (DDRC).

name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM)
name_hi: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन
short_description: Empowering rural poor women through Self Help Groups (SHGs), revolving funds, and low-interest bank loans.
benefits: Revolving Fund grant of ₹15,000, Community Investment Fund up to ₹1.5 Lakh per SHG, and bank credit linkage with 7% interest subvention for women groups.
eligible_beneficiaries: Rural women belonging to poor households organized into village-level Self Help Groups (SHGs).
income_criteria: Rural household identified through Participatory Identification of the Poor (PIP).
required_documents: Bank Account details of SHG and individual member
application_info: Contact village Community Resource Person (CRP) or Gram Panchayat Block Mission Management Unit.

name: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (Maharashtra)
short_description: Financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month to destitute elderly persons, widows, and severely disabled citizens in Maharashtra.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month directly into bank account (₹1,500 for single beneficiary; ₹2,400 for families with two or more beneficiaries).
eligible_beneficiaries: Destitute elderly individuals aged 65 or above, destitute widows, orphan children, or persons with 40%+ disability residing in Maharashtra for 15+ years.
income_criteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹50,000.
required_documents: Age Proof (Aadhaar Card / School Leaving Certificate)
Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra (15 years residency)
application_info: Submit application form at Tehsil office or apply online via Aaple Sarkar portal (aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in).

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (Maharashtra)
short_description: Monthly direct cash transfer of ₹1,500 to underprivileged adult women in Maharashtra for financial independence.
benefits: Direct financial aid of ₹1,500 per month credited directly to the woman's bank account via DBT (Total ₹18,000/year).
eligible_beneficiaries: Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned, and destitute women aged between 21 and 65 years who are residents of Maharashtra.
income_criteria: Combined annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000. Household must not own a 4-wheeler (tractor exempt).
required_documents: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate / Ration Card / Voter ID
Income Certificate (Yellow/Orange ration card serves as income proof)
Bank Passbook linked to Aadhaar (DBT active)
application_info: Apply online via Nari Shakti Doot App, Aaple Sarkar portal, or via local Anganwadi worker, CSC centre, or Ward office.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (Maharashtra)
short_description: Additional financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year from Maharashtra Government to all PM-KISAN beneficiary farmers.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 deposited directly into bank account, giving farmers a total of ₹12,000/year along with PM-KISAN.
eligible_beneficiaries: All farmers in Maharashtra who are active approved beneficiaries under the Central PM-KISAN scheme.
income_criteria: Active landholding farmer registered and verified on PM-KISAN portal.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account (DBT seeded)
application_info: Automatic disbursement to active PM-KISAN beneficiaries in Maharashtra. Verify status via mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in.

name: Lek Ladki Yojana (Maharashtra)
short_description: Financial grant of ₹1,01,000 in stages from birth until age 18 for girl children born in yellow/orange ration card families.
benefits: Staged cash grants: ₹5,000 at birth, ₹6,000 in Class 1, ₹7,000 in Class 6, ₹8,000 in Class 11, and a lump sum of ₹75,000 upon reaching age 18 (Total ₹1,01,000).
eligible_beneficiaries: Girl children born on or after 1 April 2023 in families holding yellow or orange ration cards residing in Maharashtra.
income_criteria: Yellow or Orange ration card holder family.
required_documents: Family Planning Certificate (if applicable for 2nd girl)
application_info: Apply through the nearest Anganwadi Sevika or Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) office.

name: UP Mukhyamantri Vridhajan Pension Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
short_description: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to elderly citizens aged 60+ living below poverty line in Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month (₹3,000 quarterly) transferred directly into the pensioner's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligible_beneficiaries: Citizens of Uttar Pradesh aged 60 years or above living below poverty line, not receiving any other government pension.
income_criteria: Annual family income up to ₹46,080 for rural areas and up to ₹56,460 for urban areas.
required_documents: Income Certificate from competent revenue officer
Bank Account details with active DBT
application_info: Apply online on the UP Integrated Pension Portal (sspy-up.gov.in) with Gram Panchayat or Ward verification.

name: UP Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
short_description: Financial assistance of ₹25,000 in six milestone stages from birth to graduation for girl child development in UP.
benefits: Staged cash grants totaling ₹25,000: ₹5,000 at birth, ₹2,000 after complete vaccination, ₹3,000 on admission in Class 1, ₹3,000 in Class 6, ₹5,000 in Class 9, and ₹7,000 on admission in Degree/Diploma.
eligible_beneficiaries: Permanent residents of UP with up to two girl children per family (relaxed for twins).
income_criteria: Annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Girl Child and Parents
Birth Certificate / Vaccination Card / School Admission Proof
application_info: Apply online via mksy.up.gov.in or through Block Development Office / District Probation Office.

name: Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana (Uttar Pradesh)
short_description: Free high-quality coaching and tablets for competitive exams (UPSC, UPPSC, JEE, NEET, NDA, CDS) for needy students in UP.
benefits: Free physical and online coaching classes by IAS/IPS/IFS officers, free study material, mock test series, and free tablet/digital devices to selected meritorious aspirants.
eligible_beneficiaries: Permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh preparing for national and state-level competitive examinations.
income_criteria: Economically weaker sections and middle-class aspirants.
application_info: Register online at abhyuday.up.gov.in and appear for the online eligibility assessment test.

name: Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana - MMVPY (Bihar)
short_description: Universal monthly pension of ₹400 to ₹500 for all senior citizens aged 60+ in Bihar regardless of caste or BPL status.
benefits: ₹400 per month for seniors aged 60 to 79; ₹500 per month for seniors aged 80 and above. Direct DBT to bank account.
eligible_beneficiaries: Permanent residents of Bihar aged 60 years or above, not receiving any other government/EPF pension.
income_criteria: Universal scheme: No BPL restriction. Excludes retired government employees.
application_info: Apply online via SSPMIS Bihar portal (sspmis.bihar.gov.in) or visit Block RTPS counter.

name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (Bihar)
name_hi: बिहार राज्य शिक्षा वित्त निगम - स्टूडेंट क्रेडिट कार्ड योजना
short_description: Education loan of up to ₹4 Lakh at nominal 1% interest (for girls/disabled) and 4% (for boys) for higher education.
benefits: Collateral-free educational loan up to ₹4,00,000 covering college fees, hostel, books, and laptop. Repayment starts 1 year after course completion.
eligible_beneficiaries: 12th pass students from Bihar aged under 25 pursuing degree/diploma courses in recognized institutions.
income_criteria: Open to all categories; no restrictive parental income ceiling.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of Student and Co-applicant (Parent)
application_info: Register at 7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in and visit District Registration and Counselling Centre (DRCC).

name: Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana (Bihar)
short_description: Financial incentive of up to ₹10 Lakh (50% grant + 50% interest-free loan) for setting up micro manufacturing enterprises in Bihar.
benefits: ₹10,00,000 maximum project assistance: ₹5 Lakh as direct non-repayable grant/subsidy and ₹5 Lakh as interest-free loan (1% for general men) repayable in 84 installments.
eligible_beneficiaries: 12th / ITI / Polytechnic / Graduate pass permanent residents of Bihar aged 18-50 across SC, ST, EBC, Women, and Youth categories.
income_criteria: Proprietorship firm in the applicant's name with current bank account.
required_documents: Current Account Bank Statement and Cancelled Cheque
application_info: Submit application online during annual portal window at udyami.bihar.gov.in.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
short_description: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,250 directly to bank accounts of women aged 21-60 in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250 credited on the 10th of every month directly to woman's bank account via DBT.
eligible_beneficiaries: Married, widowed, divorced, or separated women of MP aged between 21 and 60 years.
income_criteria: Annual family income must be less than ₹2,50,000. Household must own less than 5 acres of agricultural land.
required_documents: Samagra Family ID and Member ID
application_info: Submit application at special camps held in Gram Panchayat / Ward office or via cmladlibahna.mp.gov.in.

name: Mukhyamantri Jan Kalyan Sambal 2.0 Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
name_hi: मुख्यमंत्री जन कल्याण संबल 2.0 योजना (मध्य प्रदेश)
short_description: Cradle-to-grave social security card for unorganized workers: maternity aid, education incentives, and accidental relief up to ₹4 Lakh.
benefits: Maternity aid of ₹16,000, ₹4,00,000 in case of accidental death, ₹2,00,000 for normal death, ₹1,00,000 for partial disability, and free electricity subsidy.
eligible_beneficiaries: Unorganized sector workers aged 18 to 60 residing in Madhya Pradesh who are not income tax payers.
income_criteria: Unorganized laborer; family owns less than 1 hectare agricultural land.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked to Samagra (e-KYC done)
application_info: Register online at sambal.mp.gov.in or through Gram Panchayat / Ward Secretary.

name: Mukhyamantri Ayushman Arogya Yojana - MAAY (Rajasthan)
short_description: Comprehensive cashless medical health cover up to ₹25 Lakh per family per year across empaneled hospitals in Rajasthan.
benefits: Free cashless treatment up to ₹25,00,000 per family per year covering critical illnesses, organ transplants, and hospital care, plus ₹5 Lakh accidental insurance.
eligible_beneficiaries: NFSA cardholders, small & marginal farmers, contract workers, and other families registered under Jan Aadhaar in Rajasthan.
income_criteria: Free for NFSA / SECC / Small farmers; other families can enroll with nominal annual premium of ₹850.
required_documents: Jan Aadhaar Card / Jan Aadhaar Acknowledgment Receipt
application_info: Enroll through e-Mitra kiosks or online via SSO Rajasthan portal (chiranjeevi.rajasthan.gov.in).

name: Palanhar Yojana (Rajasthan)
short_description: Monthly financial aid up to ₹2,500 and annual uniform grants for orphan children and children of destitute parents in Rajasthan.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of ₹750/month for age 0-6 years and ₹1,500/month for age 6-18 years, plus annual grant of ₹2,000 for clothes and books.
eligible_beneficiaries: Orphan children, children of parents serving life imprisonment, children of widowed mothers, or children of parents with leprosy/HIV residing in Rajasthan.
income_criteria: Annual family income of the caretaker must not exceed ₹1,20,000.
required_documents: Death Certificate of Parents or valid court certificate
application_info: Apply online through e-Mitra kiosks or Social Justice and Empowerment portal (sje.rajasthan.gov.in).

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thittam (Tamil Nadu)
short_description: Monthly rights grant of ₹1,000 to female family heads to recognize unpaid domestic labor and empower women in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Direct financial aid of ₹1,000 every month deposited into the woman's bank account via DBT (Total ₹12,000/year).
eligible_beneficiaries: Female heads of family aged 21 or older who are permanent residents of Tamil Nadu.
income_criteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000. Family electricity consumption under 3,600 units per year, wetland holding under 5 acres.
required_documents: Bank Account Passbook (with active Aadhaar seed)
application_info: Register at special camps organized by Revenue Department in Fair Price Shops / e-Sevai centres.

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education - Pudhumai Penn (Tamil Nadu)
short_description: Monthly assistance of ₹1,000 to girl students who studied in government schools for pursuing higher education.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month deposited directly into student's bank account until successful completion of undergraduate degree, diploma, or ITI.
eligible_beneficiaries: Female students who studied in Tamil Nadu Government schools from Class 6 to Class 12 and enrolled in recognized higher education courses.
income_criteria: No income ceiling for eligible government school girl students.
required_documents: Transfer Certificate / EMIS Number from Government School
College Admission Proof and ID Card
application_info: Apply through the college nodal officer on the Penkalvi portal (pudhumaipenn.tn.gov.in).

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
short_description: Monthly financial aid of ₹2,000 to female heads of households in Karnataka.
benefits: ₹2,000 credited every month into the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the woman head of the family.
eligible_beneficiaries: Women listed as head of the family in Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards in Karnataka.
income_criteria: Excludes women or spouses who are income tax payers or GST filers.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the woman head and spouse
application_info: Register at Grama One, Karnataka One, or Bangalore One centres, or via Seva Sindhu portal.

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Karnataka)
short_description: Unemployment stipend of ₹3,000/month for degree holders and ₹1,500/month for diploma holders for up to 2 years.
benefits: Monthly financial support of ₹3,000 for unemployed graduates and ₹1,500 for unemployed diploma holders who passed in recent academic years.
eligible_beneficiaries: Graduates and diploma holders residing in Karnataka who remain unemployed after 6 months of course completion.
income_criteria: Unemployed youth not engaged in government/private jobs or higher education.
required_documents: Degree / Diploma Passing Certificate and Marksheets
application_info: Submit application online on the Seva Sindhu Yuva Nidhi portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in).

name: Anna Bhagya Scheme (Karnataka)
short_description: Free 10 kg food grains or direct cash transfer of ₹170 per person per month for BPL ration card families in Karnataka.
benefits: 5 kg free food grains from Central Government plus ₹170 cash transferred directly into bank account in lieu of state 5 kg quota per member.
eligible_beneficiaries: Antyodaya and BPL ration cardholders who are residents of Karnataka.
income_criteria: BPL or Antyodaya ration card holder family.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account of head of household
application_info: Automatic disbursement via DBT based on active ration card database in Karnataka.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
short_description: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 (K1) and one-time grant of ₹25,000 (K2) to keep girls in school and prevent child marriage in WB.
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 for girls aged 13-18 in classes 8-12; One-time grant of ₹25,000 at age 18 if unmarried and pursuing education or vocational training.
eligible_beneficiaries: Unmarried girls aged 13-19 enrolled in recognized schools/colleges in West Bengal.
income_criteria: Universal for all girls enrolled in education in West Bengal (income ceiling removed).
required_documents: Age Proof (Birth Certificate / Madhyamik Admit Card)
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook
application_info: Collect application form from school or college head and submit with required documents.

name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme (West Bengal)
short_description: Monthly basic income support of ₹1,200 for SC/ST women and ₹1,000 for general category women heads of families in West Bengal.
benefits: Direct monthly cash transfer of ₹1,200 per month for SC/ST women and ₹1,000 per month for other categories directly into bank account via DBT.
eligible_beneficiaries: Female family heads aged between 25 and 60 years residing in West Bengal, not in government employment.
income_criteria: Excludes permanent government employees and pensioners.
application_info: Apply at special Duare Sarkar camps organized across West Bengal or through Block Development Office.

name: Krishak Bandhu Scheme (West Bengal)
short_description: Financial assistance up to ₹10,000 per year and ₹2 Lakh death insurance to all farmers and recorded bargadars in West Bengal.
benefits: Assured financial assistance of minimum ₹4,00,00 up to ₹10,000 per year (in two installments for Kharif & Rabi), plus ₹2,00,000 one-time grant to family upon death of farmer aged 18-60.
eligible_beneficiaries: All farmers having cultivable land or registered sharecroppers (bargadars) in West Bengal.
income_criteria: No income limit. Available to all recorded landholders and bargadars.
required_documents: ROR (RoR / Khatian / Parcha) copy of cultivable land
application_info: Submit application to Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) office at block level or through Duare Sarkar camps.

name: Rythu Bandhu / Rythu Bharosa (Telangana)
short_description: Investment support of ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 per acre per year for agriculture and horticulture crops in Telangana.
benefits: Direct investment support credited to farmer's bank account twice a year for agricultural inputs like seeds, fertilizers, and field preparation.
eligible_beneficiaries: Farmer landholders who have pattadar passbooks in Telangana.
income_criteria: Landholding agricultural farmer.
application_info: Automatic disbursement through Agriculture Department based on Dharani land records.

name: Aasara Pension Scheme (Telangana)
short_description: Monthly pension of ₹2,016 for elderly, widows, and weavers, and ₹3,016 for disabled citizens in Telangana.
benefits: Direct monthly pension credited into bank or post office accounts for vulnerable elders, widows, and disabled citizens.
eligible_beneficiaries: Citizens aged 57 or above, widows aged 18+, toddy tappers, weavers, and disabled individuals residing in Telangana.
income_criteria: Rural annual household income up to ₹1.5 Lakh; urban up to ₹2 Lakh.
application_info: Apply through MeeSeva centres or local Gram Panchayat / Ward Municipal Commissioner.

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa (Andhra Pradesh)
short_description: Financial assistance of ₹13,500 per year per farmer family, including tenant farmers from SC, ST, BC, and minority groups in AP.
benefits: ₹13,500 deposited in three seasonal installments to support agricultural input costs and debt relief.
eligible_beneficiaries: Landowning farmer families and eligible registered tenant farmers in Andhra Pradesh.
income_criteria: Cultivating farmer family in Andhra Pradesh.
required_documents: Pattadar Passbook / CCRC Card for tenant farmers
application_info: Register with the local Village Agriculture Assistant (VAA) at Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK).

name: YSR Pension Kanuka (Andhra Pradesh)
short_description: Doorstep delivery of monthly pension of ₹3,000 for elderly citizens, widows, and weavers, and up to ₹10,000 for dialysis patients.
benefits: ₹3,000 per month delivered in cash on the 1st of every month directly at the citizen's doorstep by village/ward volunteers.
eligible_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60+, widows, weavers, toddy tappers, and single women residing in Andhra Pradesh.
income_criteria: Total family monthly income should not exceed ₹10,000 in rural areas and ₹12,000 in urban areas.
application_info: Submit application to the local Village/Ward Secretariat (Grama Sachivalayam).

name: Old Age Samman Allowance (Haryana Vridha Pension)
short_description: Monthly pension allowance of ₹3,000 per month for elderly citizens aged 60+ in Haryana.
benefits: ₹3,000 per month transferred automatically through Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) directly to senior citizen's bank account.
eligible_beneficiaries: Haryana residents aged 60 years or above with verified Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP).
income_criteria: Combined annual income of husband and wife should not exceed ₹3,00,000.
application_info: Automated pro-active sanction via Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) upon attaining 60 years of age, or apply via Antyodaya SARAL portal.

name: Chirayu Haryana Health Scheme
short_description: Free annual health cover of ₹5 Lakh for families with annual income up to ₹1.80 Lakh (extended to ₹3 Lakh on nominal premium) in Haryana.
benefits: Free cashless treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per year per family in all empaneled government and private hospitals across Haryana.
eligible_beneficiaries: Haryana families verified under Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP) with verified annual family income up to ₹3,00,000.
income_criteria: Free for income up to ₹1.80 Lakh; nominal ₹1,500 premium for income ₹1.80 - ₹3.00 Lakh.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
application_info: Generate card directly through any CSC or at chirayuayushmanharyana.in.

name: Old Age Pension Scheme (Punjab)
short_description: Financial monthly pension of ₹1,500 to needy elderly men (65+) and women (58+) in Punjab.
benefits: Monthly pension assistance of ₹1,500 credited to beneficiary bank accounts.
eligible_beneficiaries: Men aged 65 or above, women aged 58 or above residing in Punjab for over 3 years.
income_criteria: Annual family income not exceeding ₹60,000; landholding should not exceed 2.5 acres of canal irrigated land.
application_info: Apply via nearest Sewa Kendra or online through connect.punjab.gov.in.

name: Ashirwad Scheme / Shagun Scheme (Punjab)
short_description: Financial grant of ₹51,000 on the marriage of daughters belonging to SC, BC, and economically weaker families in Punjab.
benefits: Direct one-time grant of ₹51,000 credited to the bank account of the bride's parent or the bride for wedding expenses.
eligible_beneficiaries: Girls aged 18+ belonging to SC, BC, Christian, or EWS households residing in Punjab.
income_criteria: Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹32,790.
required_documents: Age Proof of the Bride (Aadhaar / School Certificate)
Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
application_info: Submit application form at District Social Justice Office or via local Sewa Kendra.

name: Vrudh Pension Yojana / Niradhar Vrudh Pension (Gujarat)
short_description: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 (ages 60-79) and ₹1,250 (ages 80+) for destitute senior citizens in Gujarat.
benefits: Monthly direct benefit transfer of ₹1,000 for age 60-79, and ₹1,250 for age 80 and above directly into bank account.
eligible_beneficiaries: Citizens aged 60 years and above residing in Gujarat for 10+ years without financial support from adult children.
income_criteria: Annual income must be below ₹1,20,000 for rural areas and ₹1,50,000 for urban areas.
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by Taluka Development Officer / Mamlatdar
application_info: Submit application form at Jan Seva Kendra or apply online at Digital Gujarat portal (digitalgujarat.gov.in).

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana - MYSY (Gujarat)
short_description: Tuition fee scholarship up to ₹2 Lakh/year and hostel/book grant for meritorious students in Gujarat.
benefits: 50% tuition fee assistance (up to ₹2 Lakh for medical/dental; ₹50,000 for engineering; ₹25,000 for diploma), plus ₹1,200/month lodging allowance.
eligible_beneficiaries: Students who scored 80+ percentile in 10th or 12th board exams and secured admission in higher education courses in Gujarat.
income_criteria: Annual family income not exceeding ₹6,00,000.
required_documents: Admission Slip and Fee Receipt from recognized institute
Aadhaar Card and Student Bank Passbook
application_info: Apply online at mysy.guj.nic.in with college verification.

name: Madhu Babu Pension Yojana (Odisha)
short_description: Social security pension of ₹1,000 to ₹1,400 per month for elderly, destitute widows, and persons with disabilities in Odisha.
benefits: ₹1,000/month for beneficiaries aged up to 79 years; ₹1,200/month for beneficiaries aged 80 and above; ₹1,400 for severe disability.
eligible_beneficiaries: Citizens aged 60 or above, destitute widows, and persons with disability residing in Odisha.
income_criteria: Annual family income not exceeding ₹40,000 from all sources.
application_info: Apply online at ssepd.gov.in or submit form at Block Development Office (BDO) or Municipality.

name: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation - KALIA (Odisha)
short_description: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per family for small and marginal farmers, and ₹12,500 for landless agricultural households in Odisha.
benefits: Financial aid for agricultural inputs, livelihood support for landless households, interest-free crop loans up to ₹50,000, and life insurance.
eligible_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers, sharecroppers, and landless agricultural households in Odisha.
income_criteria: Small/marginal farmer or landless agricultural household.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card linked to Bank Account
application_info: Apply through KALIA portal (kalia.odisha.gov.in) or visit local Gram Panchayat.

name: Kerala Social Security Pension
short_description: Monthly pension of ₹1,600 to elderly citizens, widows, agriculture workers, and disabled persons in Kerala.
benefits: Direct monthly pension of ₹1,600 credited to beneficiary bank accounts or delivered at home through primary cooperative societies.
eligible_beneficiaries: Permanent residents of Kerala aged 60 or older (agriculture workers aged 60+), widows, or disabled individuals.
income_criteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000.
application_info: Submit application to the local Grama Panchayat / Municipality or via Sevana Pension portal (welfarepension.lsgkerala.gov.in).

name: Orunodoi 2.0 Scheme (Assam)
short_description: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,250 directly to the bank accounts of women nominated as heads of poor families in Assam.
benefits: Direct monthly cash transfer of ₹1,250 on the 10th of every month to purchase medicines, nutrition, and essential groceries.
eligible_beneficiaries: Permanent residents of Assam with female nominee as head of household (prioritizing widows, divyang members, and destitute women).
income_criteria: Composite family income must be less than ₹2,00,000 per year.
application_info: Apply through Gaon Panchayat or Urban Local Body office during Duare Orunodoi drives.

name: Mahtari Vandan Yojana (Chhattisgarh)
short_description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 (Total ₹12,000/year) to married women aged 21+ in Chhattisgarh.
benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,000 credited directly to woman's bank account via DBT on the 1st week of every month.
eligible_beneficiaries: Married, widowed, divorced, and abandoned women aged 21 or older who are permanent residents of Chhattisgarh.
income_criteria: Excludes women whose family members are income-tax payers or regular government employees.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of applicant and husband
Marriage Certificate / Ration Card / Voter ID
application_info: Apply online at mahtarivandan.cgstate.gov.in or submit form at Anganwadi Centre / Gram Panchayat.

name: Mukhyamantri Maiyan Samman Yojana (Jharkhand)
short_description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 to ₹2,500 to women aged 18 to 50 in Jharkhand for health, nutrition, and empowerment.
benefits: Direct monthly cash transfer credited to the woman's bank account via DBT (Total ₹12,000 to ₹30,000/year).
eligible_beneficiaries: Women aged between 18 and 50 years who are permanent residents of Jharkhand and hold a ration card.
income_criteria: Ration card holder family (Red, Yellow, or Green card); no government employee in the family.
required_documents: Bank Passbook linked with Aadhaar (DBT active)
application_info: Register at special Pragyan Kendra / Aapki Yojana Aapki Sarkar camps or via mmmsy.jharkhand.gov.in.

name: Delhi Ladli Scheme (Delhi)
short_description: Financial deposits up to ₹11,000 in stages from birth to Class 12 for girl children born in Delhi.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹11,000 (if born in hospital) or ₹10,000 (if born at home) and ₹5,000 at each admission milestone (Class 1, 6, 9, 10, 12), maturing at age 18 with interest.
eligible_beneficiaries: Girl children born in Delhi whose families have resided in Delhi for at least 3 years.
income_criteria: Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000.
required_documents: Proof of 3 years residence in Delhi (Ration Card / Voter ID / Electricity Bill)
Aadhaar Card of Parents and Child
application_info: Apply through school principal or District Women and Child Development Office.

name: Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh Samman Nidhi (Himachal Pradesh)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी प्यारी बहना सुख सम्मान निधि (हिमाचल प्रदेश)
short_description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 to adult women aged 18+ in Himachal Pradesh.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month (Total ₹18,000/year) credited directly into the woman's bank account via DBT.
eligible_beneficiaries: Women aged 18 years and above residing in Himachal Pradesh (excluding families of government employees or pensioners).
income_criteria: Family should not have regular government employee or income-tax payer.
application_info: Submit application form to Tehsil Welfare Officer or local Gram Panchayat office.

name: Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand Yojana
short_description: Universal cashless secondary and tertiary health cover up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for all residents of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Universal cashless treatment up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year covering all citizen households in Uttarakhand across 175+ empaneled hospitals.
eligible_beneficiaries: All permanent resident families of Uttarakhand holding NFSA or State Ration Card.
income_criteria: Universal coverage for all residents of Uttarakhand.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
application_info: Generate golden card at nearest CSC centre, empaneled government hospital, or via ayushmanuttarakhand.org.

name: Dayanand Social Security Scheme (Goa)
short_description: Monthly financial assistance of ₹2,000 to senior citizens, widows, and disabled persons in Goa.
benefits: ₹2,000 per month deposited directly into the beneficiary's bank account via DBT.
eligible_beneficiaries: Senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled persons residing in Goa for at least 15 years.
income_criteria: Annual family income not exceeding ₹1,50,000.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card and Bank Account details
application_info: Submit application form to the Directorate of Social Welfare, Panaji, Goa.
